profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat
profile.summary: Undergraduate student with a strong background in customer service and team based work. I've worked in various areas including Full-Stack Web Development, iOS app development, provided world-class service to both consumer and small-business markets as a Services Advisor for Microsoft, and now a consultant intern in Enterprise Applications for IBM. I'm driven by my passion of working with people and technology.

positions.title: GBS Cloud Application Innovation Consultant - CoOp
Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Full-Stack web developer working on microservices-based online portal application for the University of Puerto Rico.
Utilized tools such as: PHP, HTML/CSS, JS, MySQL, Bootstrap and the Yii2 PHP Framework.
Helped manage development cycles, participated in peer code-review sessions, and responsible for testing of developed components. 
Focused on online payments, debt records and permits components of the application.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
Designed first iOS application for the University of Puerto Rico at Arecibo, which included a dynamic calendar system and a real-time push notification system. 
Responsible for backend architecture used for both versions of the application. 
Managed development cycles and core priorities for the application.
